copyedit.changes: Clean English in facts, conversation, answers, criteria, operations, gaps and repeated wrappers. copyedit.air_cost_wording: ref-17-07 preserves quoted cost 120000 and ceiling 100000. A calculable ceiling does not mean the cost fits it or that the preferred route qualifies.

resolved_groups.current_distinction: 05-08 now evaluates the inclusive BMI 35 obesity exception conjunction. 10-01 retains recurring OPD medicine exclusion and expenditure. Annualizing medicine spend cannot pass the obesity case.
19-06 now stipulates the maternity wait is met and tests spouse death against survivor continuation and the both-spouse condition. 08-01 retains a plainly unmet fresh-purchase maternity wait.

02-07 now compares three complete hypothetical quotes, marginal premium and total split cost while preserving different cover pools. 18-01 still cannot derive family pricing from a solo public example.

16-03 preserves a historical pre-move treatment event and its contract. 18-09 corrects current residence and invalidates current quote pricing. A blanket latest-address replacement fails the historical case.
17-07 now tests licensed air transport, medical origin/destination and benefit ceiling. 17-01 retains unresolved hospital branch identity and network scope.
01-01 now tests new-issue free-look timing from receipt and unknown refund deductions. 20-01 preserves the original Kota first-policy conversation and insured/budget clarification.

04-04 adds a reported per-claim cap on the co-pay itself, changing the conditional share from 30000 to 10000 and reversing cash feasibility. 01-02 retains an uncapped premium-versus-cash scenario. Original cap authority remains unresolved.

16-04 stipulates accepted spouse addition but tests a separate one-year wellness clock. 03-03 retains unaccepted midterm adoption and member-specific credit. Acceptance alone cannot pass the wellness case.
06-04 supplies a later bounded pathology finding and named prior unsupported cancer conclusion to retract while retaining admission history. 05-10 retains an abnormal test with pending diagnosis.
09-04 now compares actual PRP injection with explicit exclusion and a differently scoped hematopoietic table entry. 06-10 retains recipient-linked donor surgery and excluded cost categories.

04-08 scores purchase suitability against a fixed hospital requirement. 17-04 explicitly stipulates an existing accepted restricted option and scores entitlement against a conflicting broad network. Changing a purchase preference cannot settle the issued contract scope.

13-07 scores pending group migration; 15-01 scores receiving-insurer acceptance of exact retail credits; 19-07 supplies an accepted person-specific group extension that covers the surgery date. A generic pending-means-no-cover answer fails the extension case.

06-06 scores an unaccepted recurrence restriction and specific protection gap. 07-10 scores a reported issued schedule conflict and lawful precedence. 18-06 explicitly scores owner isolation and forbids cross-owner retrieval or global publication of the private offer.
